name: AthleteNutritionPlanTracker
tagline: Fuel for the work required – day-type targets, intake compliance and a batch-tested supplement register in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete sports-nutrition module for performance departments: practitioners set g/kg fuelling templates per training day type, the app calculates each athlete's gram targets from body mass, compares logged intake, flags under-fuelling, low protein, low fluid and body-mass drops, runs the practitioner review queue and checks every supplement against the club's batch-tested register. Guidance and documentation aid only.
features: Day-type fuelling templates (g/kg CHO/protein/fat) with per-day overrides
Gram, energy and fluid targets from body mass
Compliance KPIs, 14-day trend and carbohydrate vs target by day type
Week planner with copy previous week
Under-fuelled, low protein, low fluid and body-mass-drop flags
Practitioner review queue with bulk sign-off and status rules
Batch-tested supplement register with not-permitted / unregistered / missing-batch checks
Athlete trends: intake vs target and body mass
Search, quick filters, filter drawer, sort, group, CSV export, undo
